interpretation: KAT6A is extremely loss-of-function intolerant (pLI=1, LOEUF=0.079, top decile). Strongly supports that heterozygous loss (haploinsufficiency) is deleterious and disease-relevant. Note: gnomAD LoF constraint is dominated by NMD-competent PTCs (last-exon variants are LOFTEE low-confidence), so this metric primarily evidences the haploinsufficiency baseline rather than the NMD-escape branch.
